title: Knowledge Base
subtitle: Structured, versioned, reviewable knowledge with a personal library.
myLibraryDesc: Your personal knowledge entries. Private to you until you publish them into the shared base.
noPersonalEntries: You have no personal entries yet.
personalEntryNotFoundDesc: This personal entry doesn't exist, or it isn't yours.
personalEntryArchivedHint: Archived entries are read-only. They stay for the record but can no longer be edited or published.
publishPersonalEntryDesc: Submits this entry for review. On approval a new global entry is created in the target collection and this personal entry is archived.
publishTargetHint: Which collection this entry is published into. Required before publishing.
publishNeedsTarget: Select a target collection before publishing.
publishAlreadyOpen: A publish request for this entry is already awaiting review.
editInvalidatesOpenSubmission: Saving new content closes the publish request awaiting review — submit again afterwards.
deletePersonalEntryConfirm: Delete personal entry "{{name}}"? It is archived rather than erased, and disappears from your library.
deletePersonalEntryOpenSubmission: This entry has a publish request awaiting review. Deleting it closes that request too.
name: Name
keywordsHint: Distinctive terms that auto-surface this entry when they appear in a session. Prefer specific words (proper nouns, error codes, API names); avoid short or generic ones. No keywords = never auto-injected.
metaDesc: Edit the entry's title, tags, keywords, and status.
settingsReadOnlyHint: You don't have write permission; submit a draft for review to propose changes.
controlledTagsHint: Controlled tags required to read this entry (compartment).
reviewTagsHint: Tags a reviewer must hold to review changes to this entry.
aclOwnerHint: Owner user id; the owner may edit directly and review.
directEditDesc: You have write permission — changes apply to the global version immediately.
directEditHint: Regular users must create a draft and submit it for review.
noDraft: You don't have a draft for this entry yet.
driftDesc: Your draft is based on an older version of this entry. The main version has advanced {{count}} revision(s) since. The current main version is shown here; your draft is shown as a diff against it.
driftDesc_zero: Your draft is based on an older version of this entry; the main version has since changed. The current main version is shown here; your draft is shown as a diff against it.
rebaseHint: Rebase merges the main changes into your draft so you can continue from the latest version.
rebaseSuccess: Draft rebased onto the latest version.
rebaseNoop: Your draft is already based on the latest version.
rebaseConflictDesc: Your changes and the main changes overlap and can't be merged automatically. Review the versions below and edit your draft manually.
conflictDesc: The current version changed since this draft was based on it. Resolve the conflict by editing the final content below.
accessControlDesc: Manage classification levels, controlled tags, and user permissions (admin only).
levelsDesc: Defines the classification hierarchy. Higher rank = stricter access. Users need clearance at or above an entry's level to read it.
tagsDesc: Tags categorize entries. Controlled tags act as access compartments — users need explicit grants to read entries with these tags.
usersTabDesc: Click a user to view and manage their knowledge-base permissions.
selectUserHint: Select a user above to manage their permissions.
noAccessibleEntries: No entries accessible with current settings.
previewDisclaimer: Preview is approximate. Admin users and entry owners always have full access regardless of grants.
entryAclDesc: Set the classification level, controlled tags, and review tags for this entry (admin only).
accessibleUsersDesc: Based on current settings, these users can read this entry:
noAccessibleUsers: No users can access this entry (only admins).
deleteCollectionConfirm: Delete collection "{{name}}" and all its entries?
linkAddDesc: Create a directed, typed association from this entry to another readable entry.
linkNoOutgoing: This entry doesn't link to anything yet.
linkNoIncoming: No entries link to this one.
userAclDesc: Assign knowledge-base permissions for {{username}}: clearance level and tags.
userAclClearanceHint: Highest classification level this user may read.
userAclTagsHint: Controlled tags this user is granted access to.
userAclReviewHint: Tags this user may review (approve changes to entries requiring these tags).
tagTypesDesc: Categories for tags (organization / position / permission / other). Builtin types cannot be deleted.
collectionAclDesc: The collection is the first access gate: a user who cannot read the collection cannot read any entry inside it, even a public one.
collectionAclLevelHint: Clearance required to see this collection at all. Empty = public.
collectionAclTagsHint: Controlled tags a user must hold to read this collection (compartment).
collectionAclOwnerHint: The owner bypasses the collection gate and may manage it.
collectionAclWarning: Raising the level or adding controlled tags immediately hides this collection — and everything in it — from users without matching grants.
bulkGrantDesc: Give the same credential to several users in one action. Up to 200 users per request.
bulkGrantAdminNote: Admins already have full access and are excluded.
bulkGrantLimitHint: Select at most 200 users per request.
transferOwnerEntryDesc: The new owner may edit this entry directly and review changes to it. You will lose owner privileges unless you are an admin.
transferOwnerCollectionDesc: The new owner may manage this collection and bypasses its access gate. You will lose owner privileges unless you are an admin.
deleteEntryWarning: This permanently removes the entry, all its revisions, and its links. This cannot be undone.
deleteEntryConfirmLabel: Type the entry title to confirm
subFlowWithdrawDesc: Reviewers will no longer see it. Your personal entry and its content stay untouched, and you can submit again later.
subFlowWithdrawReasonPlaceholder: e.g. found a mistake, resubmitting after a fix
subFlowResubmitDesc: Creates a new publish request from your personal entry's current content, linked to this one so the reviewer sees which round it is. Save any pending edits first.
subFlowResubmitNotePlaceholder: What you changed since the last round
subFlowSupersededHint: Auto-closed because the content changed after submitting — not a reviewer decision.
driftTakeMainTitle: Discard your changes and take main?
driftTakeMainDesc: Your personal version's content is replaced by the current main version. Your local edits are lost and cannot be recovered.
driftTakeMainHint: Use this when main already covers what you were writing and you just want to catch up.
reviewScopeAdmin: You are an administrator: you can review every publish request.
reviewScopeNone: You hold no review grants and cannot publish into any collection, so nothing is routed to you for review. Ask an administrator for a review tag or collection write access.
reviewScopeTagsHint: You can review an entry when you hold ALL of its review tags.
reviewScopeCollectionsHint: New standalone entries submitted to these collections come to you.
reviewScopeTruncated: Partial list (too many to show all).
